decisions.decision: Middleware precedence changed from Host>cookie>query to Host>query>cookie
decisions.rationale: root is a KNOWN_MARKET so a cookie=root trapped users on root page permanently; query param must override stale cookie to allow market-hopping

decisions.decision: Vercel CI failure is NOT ESLint — local pnpm lint shows only warnings, 0 errors
decisions.rationale: All any[] usages have working eslint-disable-next-line comments. True cause: missing SANITY env vars on Vercel prevent build-time data fetching for SSG pages.

decisions.decision: Design inconsistency likely caused by Sanity empty states on Vercel, not CSS bugs
decisions.rationale: CSS token system verified: --accent oklch(0.14 0 0), --card oklch(0.11 0 0), --muted oklch(0.13 0 0) — all dark. No bg-white/bg-gray in page files. Once Sanity loads real data on Vercel the pages should look correct.
